name: Domination Debut Bout ~Shinjin Chika Joshi Boxer no Sainan~
original_name: Domination Debut Bout ～新人地下女子ボクサーの災難～
source:
A busty office worker, Risa fights in an underground boxing arena in order to repay her debt. 
However, she is completely beaten up by a male boxer who is much stronger than her...!??
